roleInfo.name: Reindeer
roleInfo.description: Deliver 5 Presents or fire Santa to win!

roleInfo.name: Elf
roleInfo.description: Deliver 6 lumps of Charcoal or get Santa elected Courier after the 3rd Charcoal to win!

roleInfo.name: Santa
roleInfo.description: Deliver 6 lumps of Charcoal or get elected Courier after the 3rd Charcoal to win! You don't know who the other Elves are, but they know who you are.

elf_separator.tooltip: If Santa is elected Courier after this point, the Elves win!

tracker_0.tooltip: 0 deliveries have failed since the last gift. When 3 deliveries have failed, you must deliver the top gift in the deck.

tracker_1.tooltip: 1 delivery has failed since the last gift. When 3 deliveries have failed, you must deliver the top gift in the deck.

tracker_2.tooltip: 2 deliveries have failed since the last gift. When 3 deliveries have failed, you must deliver the top gift in the deck.

tracker_3.tooltip: 3 deliveries have failed since the last gift. Deliver the top gift in the deck!

reindeer.tooltip: This Present hasn't been delivered yet.

reindeer_last.tooltip: This Present hasn't been delivered yet. When it gets delivered, the Reindeers win!

reindeer_last_done.tooltip: This Present has been delivered! The Reindeers win!

elf.tooltip: This Charcoal hasn't been delivered yet.

elf_peek.tooltip: This Charcoal hasn't been delivered yet. When delivered, the Packer gets to look at the top 3 gifts in the deck.

elf_peek_done.tooltip: This Charcoal has been delivered! The Packer gets to look at the top 3 cards in the deck.

elf_check.tooltip: This Charcoal hasn't been delivered yet. When delivered, the Packer gets to check another player and learn their team.

elf_check_done.tooltip: This Charcoal has been delivered! The Packer gets to check another player and learn their team.

elf_delegate.tooltip: This Charcoal hasn't been delivered yet. When delivered, the Packer gets to choose the next Packer.

elf_delegate_done.tooltip: This Charcoal has been delivered! The Packer gets to choose the next Packer.

elf_fire.tooltip: This Charcoal hasn't been delivered yet. When delivered, the Packer gets to fire another player.

elf_fire_done.tooltip: This Charcoal has been delivered! The Packer gets to fire another player.

elf_strike.tooltip: This Charcoal hasn't been delivered yet. When delivered, the Packer gets to fire another player. Packers and Couriers can now also strike, preventing deliveries.

elf_strike_done.tooltip: This Charcoal has been delivered! The Packer gets to fire another player. Packers and Couriers can now also strike, preventing deliveries.

elf_last.tooltip: This Charcoal gift hasn't been delivered yet. When it is delivered, the Elves win!

elf_last_done.tooltip: This Charcoal has been delivered! The Elves win!
